77.name: Porsche of Legends
77.notes: The World League (MP1) is being revamped with a new Champion tier (between Platinum and Legend), fewer sub-tiers (4 to 3), and permanent progression past Silver tier (players reaching Gold will now stay there after resets)

81.name: Touge Masters
81.new_features: Drift Mode was introduced on the JDM Turbofest Spotlight
81.notes: The Infiniti Project Black S Ⓓ was delisted for non-owners due to licensing issues. As a result, its Showroom event was also removed / Career was renamed to Home, and moved to the left of Legend Pass / After the testing period, the shop redesign is now available for most of the platforms, except for players on iOS and PC versions

83.name: Sunset Speedway
83.new_features: Ultimate Legend Pass credits doubled to 20,000,000 (up from 10M). Ghost Slipstream returns to the MP1 mode rotation, alternating with Ghost and No Takedowns. Console ad-ticket cap reverted to 20/day (up from 8). Club Series becomes a permanent fixture on the final weekend of every season going forward.
83.notes: This season leans into Endurance racing. IMSA headlines the Spotlight event with a brand-new mode, alongside several other special events competing for attention.
